data.situation:
At ten on Saturday, 22 May, Jo led Maya through the garden gate to the outdoor fitness area. A few people were using the exercise bars, while two children waited beside the skateboard ramp. A rope marked the boundary between the two spaces. Near one post, a loose board lay across the path. Jo called it a hazard and asked the activity leader to look. A wheel could catch on its edge; there was a danger of someone falling. The leader brought a cone and moved the waiting children back. Maya carried their water bottles to the fence. The morning session had not begun, and the leader wanted to check the area for everyone's safety before opening the ramp. RAMP AREA — MORNING CHECK
Please wait beside the fence while the activity leader checks the surface. Keep bags and bottles outside the rope boundary. The outdoor fitness area remains open, but the skateboard ramp has not opened yet. A cone marks the loose board reported this morning. Tell the leader if you notice another hazard.

readingBlocks.zh: 5月22日星期六十点，乔带着玛雅穿过花园门，来到户外健身区。几个人在使用锻炼横杆，两个孩子在滑板坡道旁等候。一根绳子划出了两片区域的边界。其中一根柱子旁，一块松动的木板横在小路上。乔说它是个隐患，请活动负责人来看。轮子可能卡在木板边缘，存在有人摔倒的危险。负责人拿来一个路锥，让等候的孩子退后。玛雅把他们的水瓶拿到围栏边。上午的活动尚未开始，负责人希望先为大家的安全检查场地，再开放坡道。

readingBlocks.en:
RAMP AREA — MORNING CHECK
Please wait beside the fence while the activity leader checks the surface. Keep bags and bottles outside the rope boundary. The outdoor fitness area remains open, but the skateboard ramp has not opened yet. A cone marks the loose board reported this morning. Tell the leader if you notice another hazard.
readingBlocks.zh:
坡道区域——晨间检查
活动负责人检查地面时，请在围栏边等候。包和水瓶请放在围绳边界外。户外健身区仍开放，但滑板坡道尚未开放。路锥标出了今早发现的松动木板。如果发现其他隐患，请告诉负责人。
